challenge.method: Compare the title, reprint and author information with IBM Research's publication record. Challenge whether the use in CMS makes REXX only a host command interpreter or folds later Rexx-derived identities into the original language. Cross-check RexxLA's product descriptions.
challenge.results: The paper identifies a language usable for general and command programming and treats CMS as an implementation environment. RexxLA distinguishes an implementation of Classic Rexx from Object Rexx and its implementation, and lists NetRexx separately. The catalog authenticates the original article and does not supply a second source lineage. Sources: https://research.ibm.com/publications/design-of-the-rexx-language and https://www.rexxla.org/products.srsp

limitations: This is the historically identified core language. The record does not establish the syntax or compatibility of later extensions and implementations.
